$comment: Machine-readable capability status. Every level below was established by running the referenced command in this repository. Entries not personally re-verified in a session carry verificationLevel 'unaudited' rather than an optimistic guess. Markdown must not contradict this file.

levelDefinitions.not_implemented: No working code path. Entry points must return blocked/not_implemented.
levelDefinitions.unaudited: Code exists but was not verified in this session. Do not cite as evidence.
levelDefinitions.offline_verified: Deterministic behaviour proven by the test suite; no model or Harmony.
levelDefinitions.real_model_verified: Executed against real model weights producing real artifacts.
levelDefinitions.real_harmony_smoke_verified: One successful operation against a licensed Harmony with evidence.
levelDefinitions.shot_verified: A complete shot was produced, rendered, reviewed and approved.

knownFailures: Single-person only: pose runs on the highest-scoring detection; multi-person tracking is not implemented.
No temporal smoothing; per-frame video use will jitter.
Validated on one photographic fixture only; stylised/animated line art is unvalidated.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run across a real video sequence and measure temporal stability; validate on genuine animation line art rather than a photograph.

knownFailures: DWPose is evaluation-only: COCO-WholeBody training-data terms have not been approved for commercial production. RTMPose remains the required production default.

On the cartoon clip, median per-keypoint movement increased after smoothing from 0.0485 to 3.6150 px/frame because many raw points were nearly static; p95 improved from 35.3132 to 17.8263 px/frame. The current aggregate jitter objective is not a reliable production-quality metric for stylised animation.
Single person only. Identity is IoU + pose similarity, not tracking.
Validated on one five-second published 2D cartoon clip with a plain background; no varied-style, occlusion or multi-character robustness data.
capabilities.blockingReason: Production use remains blocked until a commercially approved pose provider replaces the DWPose evaluation provider and the temporal-quality metric is validated across several 2D animation styles. Real evaluation inference is verified.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Implement RTMPose with verified official weights, define a motion-aware temporal metric that separates static points from true articulation, and repeat acceptance on several published 2D cartoon styles.

knownFailures: Previous version returned InbetweenPIR entries pointing at /tmp/animeinbet_output/*.png that were never written, with a hardcoded confidence of 0.95.
capabilities.blockingReason: No model implementation and no weights. All entry points now return not_implemented with realInferenceExecuted=false.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Integrate a real inbetweening model and produce actual image files on disk with hashes.

knownFailures: Before this session the downloader declared expected SHA-256 values that matched neither file and never compared them; the manifest recorded whatever bytes arrived.
The manifest stored machine-specific absolute paths, so the ML stack did not resolve on any other checkout.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Apply the same verified-hash + relative-path pattern to the remaining model families (VoxCPM, Whisper, SAM).

knownFailures: Headless Harmony bridge exposes no Node View coordinates, node connections, per-frame exposures or keyframe interpolation.
capabilities.blockingReason: Real Harmony read blocked: harmony.open_project raises RuntimeError: Invalid license (no FlexNet license file).
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Execute the QtScript notifier inside a licensed Harmony GUI session and capture one real manual edit.

knownFailures: ToonBoom.harmony imports successfully (python 3.9.25) but open_project raises RuntimeError: Invalid license.
capabilities.blockingReason: No FlexNet license on this machine: /usr/local/flexlm/licenses/license.dat absent, LM_LICENSE_FILE unset.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Any successful open_project + readback against a licensed Harmony.

knownFailures: Bezier control points come from a tangent heuristic, not a least-squares (Schneider) fit; curve fidelity is unmeasured.
capabilities.blockingReason: Not audited in any session so far. Zhang-Suen thinning plus cubic Bezier fitting is present and reads correctly, but no run was executed and curve fidelity against a source centerline has never been measured, so no level above unaudited can be claimed.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Measure max deviation between fitted curves and the source centerline on a real drawing; the preliminary claim that this produced 'broken polygons' was NOT reproduced — Zhang-Suen thinning plus cubic Bezier fitting is present.

capabilities.blockingReason: Not started. Deliberately deferred: building a shot factory on top of a perception layer that fabricated keypoints would have industrialised a false result.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: ShotManifest schema, deterministic compiler and an offline golden-path bundle.

knownFailures: Single-person only. With several people the highest-IoU detection wins and identity can swap silently.
capabilities.blockingReason: Recorded capability gap for Sprint 1. Deliberately deferred; LocoTrack not integrated.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Multi-person association with stable IDs measured on footage containing at least two people.

knownFailures: Fabrication detection is heuristic: it flags small printable-ASCII media containing known placeholder markers. A large or binary fake would not be caught.
The evidence gate only enforces bundles under docs/evidence; output/ is reported as a warning because it is gitignored scratch.
Gates check that evidence exists and hashes match; they cannot judge whether the evidence supports the claim.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run the gates in CI against a real runner; CI has never executed on this repository (0 of 13 historical runs started a job).

knownFailures: GitHub Actions has not executed this revision; CI parity was validated locally and in a fresh Python 3.12 environment.
The local developer environments remain split by service; package scripts orchestrate them, while CI installs a combined dependency set.
No real Harmony execution is included because the installed Harmony runtime has no configured FlexNet license.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run the updated workflow on GitHub Actions and retain its job URL; this offline_verified entry must not be promoted from local results alone.

knownFailures: Block semantics only: when the MediaPipe face_landmarker.task weights are absent the provider returns a blocked sequence with realInferenceExecuted=False. No blendshape coefficients or landmarks are fabricated.
Single-face only: num_faces=1. Multi-face tracking is not implemented.
No facial transformation matrix validated against ground-truth head pose.
Mediapipe python package is not a declared dependency; the lazy import path is exercised only when the package is installed.
capabilities.blockingReason: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker model task file is not present under services/ml-runtime/weights/mediapipe/. Download face_landmarker.task from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/latest/face_landmarker.task and place it at that repo-relative path, or set HARMONY_FACE_LANDMARKER_TASK to an absolute path, then re-run the video pipeline. Until then every call returns blocked with realInferenceExecuted=false.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run track_face_performance() over a short real face-video fixture with the .task weights present and confirm: at least one frame carries 478 landmarks and 52 measured blendshape coefficients, transformationMatrix is 16 floats, and realInferenceExecuted=true in provenance.

knownFailures: Block semantics only: when WhisperX weights for the requested model (default large-v3) are absent the provider returns a blocked sequence with realInferenceExecuted=False and zero words/pauses/phonemes. No timestamps are fabricated.
HuggingFace cache is intentionally NOT used as a managed location: refusing to depend on ~/.cache/huggingface keeps the supply chain explicit.
MFA aligner integration is optional and remains blocked unless 'mfa' binary is on PATH or the alignmanager python package is importable.
WhisperX python package is not a declared project dependency; the lazy import path returns blocked until the operator installs it.
capabilities.blockingReason: WhisperX weights are not present under services/ml-runtime/weights/whisperx/<model>/ and the whisperx python package may not be importable. Download the requested model (default large-v3) into services/ml-runtime/weights/whisperx/, or set HARMONY_WHISPER_MODEL_PATH to an absolute model file/dir, and `pip install whisperx` before re-running. Until then every call returns blocked with realInferenceExecuted=false.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Run transcribe_audio() over a short real speech fixture with WhisperX weights and the whisperx package present and confirm: words[] is non-empty with real measured confidence, speechRateWpm > 0, pauses[] derived from measured gaps, and realInferenceExecuted=true in provenance. Optionally verify MFA phoneme alignment writes non-empty phonemes[] without holes inside the utterance.

knownFailures: Blocks by hostname only; a test could still reach an external service through a non-fetch client (raw http/https module, child process curl).
dotenv is neutralised by monkey-patching its config(); a future loader that reads .env directly would bypass this.
capabilities.nextRequiredProof: Extend the guard to node:http/https agents so non-fetch clients cannot reach external hosts either.

fixtureNotes.finding: This is a 512x512 photograph of an astronaut (STS-93 mission patch visible), i.e. the standard scikit-image 'astronaut' sample, not an animation character. ML claims described as verified on a 'character' were verified on a stock photograph.
fixtureNotes.impact: Any capability claiming validation for stylised animation line art via this fixture is unproven.

fixtureNotes.finding: All 71 mp4 files under output/ are fabricated: 17-byte ASCII 'MOCK_VIDEO_STREAM' or 34-byte 'SIMULATED_VIDEO_STREAM_PLACEHOLDER'. Zero decode, including one named SC_TEST_REAL_preview.mp4.
fixtureNotes.impact: Any past claim of rendered preview video is false. Verified with ffprobe on 2026-07-27: 0 decodable of 71.

fixtureNotes.finding: services/ml-runtime/weights/mediapipe/ and services/ml-runtime/weights/whisperx/<model>/ are deliberately NOT checked into the repository: the providers refuse any path that resolves through the HuggingFace cache, so a real run requires the operator to download real weights. Blocked sequences with realInferenceExecuted=false are the only permitted output in the absence of weights.
fixtureNotes.impact: Capabilities perception.face_blendshapes and perception.speech_timing sit at contract_verified until a real run produces 52 measured blendshape coefficients / non-empty measured word timestamps with realInferenceExecuted=true.
